scope: The photographed Lao Tu Street entrance and principal temple buildings of Quán Âm Pagoda in Chợ Lớn as documented in 2008.

references.filename: Quan Âm Pagoda - Front entrance edited.jpg

originalReview.notes: The exact photograph shows the triple red entrance, shallow teal roof eaves, layered rose tile roofs, yellow accents and decorative green roof curves.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact entrance image is DoktorMax’s own public-domain work. Its first native revision ties the author, uploader and dedication. The camera date and published month are both in mid-2008. Interior objects and the separate garden across the street are outside this scope.
